implemented: Freezes training/validation boundary, sample floor, effect direction/threshold, mechanism, and falsifier before evaluation.
Requires matched-control net-alpha observations with unique evidence IDs and one aggregate per development session.
Rejects validation-window or non-development inputs and retains the complete development evidence rows.
Keeps proposals pending independent review and structurally forbids paper-strategy mutation or trial-budget changes.
Persists proposals append-only and rejects changed records.
blockers: Inputs and data digest are caller-provided and not bound to the authoritative development data registry.
No independent review workflow or paper strategy registry integration is connected.
Development association and synthetic tests do not prove causal mechanism or prospective edge.
